question: The 'Keel Laying' ceremony of the first of the five Fleet Support Ships (FSS) for the Indian Navy was held at which place in November 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hindustan Shipyard Ltd., Visakhapatnam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Keel Laying** ceremony marks a significant step in the construction of a ship, where the keel (the backbone of the ship) is laid down, symbolizing the formal start of the ship's construction.
 
• This ceremony for the **first Fleet Support Ship (FSS)** for the Indian Navy took place at the **Hindustan Shipyard Ltd.**, located in **Visakhapatnam**, Andhra Pradesh.
 
• Hindustan Shipyard Ltd. is a **premier shipbuilding organization in India**, known for its expertise in building and repairing ships and submarines.
 
• The Fleet Support Ships (FSS) are designed to provide logistical support to naval vessels, including **fuel, provisions, and ammunition**.
 
• The project is a part of India’s initiative to **enhance its indigenous shipbuilding capabilities**, aligned with the **‘Make in India’ campaign**.
 
• This development strengthens the **Indian Navy's operational capabilities** and supports its strategic objectives in the Indian Ocean region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Ltd., Cochin**__

 __
 
• **Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Ltd.**, located in **Mumbai, Maharashtra**, is a leading shipyard known for constructing warships and submarines for the Indian Navy.
 
• It has built significant naval projects, including **Scorpene-class submarines** and destroyers like the **INS Kolkata**.
 
 
 
• **Goa Shipyard Limited**__
 __
 
• Located in **Goa**, this shipyard specializes in building **offshore patrol vessels, fast patrol vessels**, and other medium-sized naval vessels.
 
• It plays a critical role in **supporting coastal security** and shipbuilding for the Indian Navy and Coast Guard.
 
 
 
• **ABG Shipyard Ltd., Mumbai**__
 
 
• ABG Shipyard Ltd., based in **Surat, Gujarat**, was previously one of India's largest private shipbuilding companies.
 
• It focused on constructing **commercial ships** like bulk carriers and container ships, but it faced financial difficulties in recent years.
